technical_decisions: Áp dụng f64 affine matrix, xác định rõ model/local/world/CPlane, thứ tự nhân ma trận và copy vs modify policy.
Non-uniform/negative/zero determinant, homogeneous component và unit conversion phải được phân loại; từ chối NaN/inf trước commit.
Gumball/commandline có preview tạm và một commit duy nhất, Undo/Redo và Cancel không để shape/cache mồ côi.

input.purpose: path frames for downstream Gem/Settings arrangements

positive.setup: Create the geometry and select the inputs required by: path frames for downstream Gem/Settings arrangements
positive.expected: Affine transform maintains exact BRep where supported, valid transformed axes/units and stable object ID or explicit copy policy, undo/redo restores geometry.

negative.setup: Zero determinant or NaN matrix, non-invertible frame or cancel before commit.
negative.expected: Explicit domain error; document IDs, BRep cache, selection and undo journal unchanged

invariants: No success with only tessellation when an exact BRep is required
Do not infer success from an unrun test

golden_test_design.input: straight rail 0..10 mm along Z, samples at arclength 0,5,10
golden_test_design.positive_assertions: orthonormal frames, origins at expected distances, handedness consistent
golden_test_design.negative_assertions: zero tangent / rail discontinuity returns diagnostic

m03_luna_execution_contract.manual_references_precision: Many references are inherited parent-L2 page ranges, not command-exact citations
invariants: OCCT BRep/Geom is truth for exact geometry; mesh/tessellation only derived
No partial document commit on failure or cancellation
Stable object and subobject identity or explicit broken-reference error
No fabricated test receipts, measured values, or manual review
m03_luna_execution_contract.agent_handoff: Read this L3 first, then precisely one L4 child. Do not start until prerequisite gates and real source available.
